Job Description View All Jobs View Our Website Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications. About Us: We’re an international team who specialise in building technology products & then helping brands grow with multi-channel demand generation marketing. We have in-house experience working for Fortune 500 companies, e-commerce brands, technology Saa S companies & VC-funded startups. We have assisted over a dozen billion dollar companies with consulting, technology, operations, and digital agency capabilities in managing their unique brand online. We have a fun and friendly work culture that also encourages employees personally and professionally. Ebiz ON has many values that are important to our success as a company: integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness and teamwork. We thrive on the idea of making life better for people by providing them with peace of mind. The people here love what they do because everyone from management all way down understands how much it means living up close-to someones' ideals which allows every day feel less stressful knowing each person has somebody cheering him. Equal Opportunity Employer: Ebiz ON is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees, and we will consider any qualified applicant without regard to race or other prohibited characteristics. Flexible Timings: Flexible working hours are the new normal. We at Ebiz On believe giving employees freedom to choose when to work, how to work. It helps them thrive and also balance their life better. Global Clients Exposure: Our goal is to provide excellent customer service and we want our employees to work closely with clients from around the world. That's why you'll find us working closely with clients from around the world through Microsoft Teams, Zoom and other video conferencing tools. Retreats & Celebrations: With annual retreats, quarterly town halls and festive celebrations we have a lot of opportunities to get together. Leave Policy: Leave policies allow for 52 weekends and 32 days of leave per year, plus maternity, paternity or sabbatical allowances. Associate Consultant – Business Development ll Noida Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India Full Time Experienced Share Ebiz ON is looking for energetic, ambitious, and analytical professionals to join our Business Consulting & Development team. In this role, you’ll work with international clients to drive business growth, consult on e Commerce strategies, and play a key part in expanding Ebiz ON’s global footprint. This is an excellent opportunity for fresh MBA graduates or early-career professionals passionate about sales, consulting, relationship building, and global business strategy. What You’ll Do Identify, engage, and build relationships with potential clients across global markets. Consult clients on e Commerce and digital growth strategies to enhance their online business performance. Manage the complete sales cycle — from prospecting and outreach to proposal creation, pitching, and closure. Develop customized business proposals and client presentations showcasing Ebiz ON’s digital commerce capabilities. Collaborate with marketing, technology, and delivery teams to design solutions tailored to client needs. Define and support the execution of clients’ overall e Commerce growth roadmap. Maintain an active sales pipeline and achieve quarterly business goals. Track and analyze sales data, trends, and performance metrics using CRM tools. Stay updated on market developments, emerging digital trends, and competitive movements to identify new opportunities. What We’re Looking For 0–3 years of experience in Business Development, Consulting, Inside Sales, or Client Engagement. Excellent communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills. Strong analytical and strategic thinking with a solution-oriented approach. Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams. High sense of ownership, motivation, and resilience to meet targets. MBA or equivalent degree from a reputed institute (IIMs, IITs, FORE, IMT, NMIMS, etc.) About Us Ebiz ON is a global team specializing in building technology products and driving growth through multi-channel digital marketing. We’ve partnered with Fortune companies, e Commerce brands, Saa S firms, and VC-funded startups—helping over a dozen billion-dollar companies with consulting, technology, and digital transformation. We take pride in our fun, collaborative, and growth-focused culture built on integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness, and teamwork. Our goal is simple—make life better by giving people peace of mind through impactful solutions. Why Join Us Equal Opportunity Employer: We value diversity and inclusivity across all teams. Flexible Timings: Enjoy the freedom to balance work and life your way. Global Exposure: Collaborate with clients worldwide through virtual platforms like Teams and Zoom. Retreats & Celebrations: Connect, unwind, and celebrate with fun Fridays and festive events. Job Description View All Jobs View Our Website Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications. About Us: We’re an international team who specialise in building technology products & then helping brands grow with multi-channel demand generation marketing. We have in-house experience working for Fortune 500 companies, e-commerce brands, technology Saa S companies & VC-funded startups. We have assisted over a dozen billion dollar companies with consulting, technology, operations, and digital agency capabilities in managing their unique brand online. We have a fun and friendly work culture that also encourages employees personally and professionally. Ebiz ON has many values that are important to our success as a company: integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness and teamwork. We thrive on the idea of making life better for people by providing them with peace of mind. The people here love what they do because everyone from management all way down understands how much it means living up close-to someones' ideals which allows every day feel less stressful knowing each person has somebody cheering him. Equal Opportunity Employer: Ebiz ON is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees, and we will consider any qualified applicant without regard to race or other prohibited characteristics. Flexible Timings: Flexible working hours are the new normal. We at Ebiz On believe giving employees freedom to choose when to work, how to work. It helps them thrive and also balance their life better. Global Clients Exposure: Our goal is to provide excellent customer service and we want our employees to work closely with clients from around the world. That's why you'll find us working closely with clients from around the world through Microsoft Teams, Zoom and other video conferencing tools. Retreats & Celebrations: With annual retreats, quarterly town halls and festive celebrations we have a lot of opportunities to get together. Leave Policy: Leave policies allow for 52 weekends and 32 days of leave per year, plus maternity, paternity or sabbatical allowances. Digital Marketing Fresher || Noida Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India Full Time Entry Level Share Ebiz ON is looking for Graduate Fresher to join our team in the Noida office. Responsibilities Assist in planning, creating, and managing Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, and Video). Conduct keyword research and analyze competitors to optimize campaign performance. Monitor campaign performance and generate regular reports. Optimize ads, bids, and budgets to improve ROI and achieve campaign goals. Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in digital advertising. Required Skills &

Ebiz ON || Email Marketing Specialist || Dehradun Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India Full Time Experienced Share We are seeking a creative and data-driven Email Marketing Specialist with 1+ year of experience to plan, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving engagement, increasing conversions, and improving customer retention through effective email strategies. Plan, create, and execute email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and automated workflows. Design and develop engaging email content aligned with brand guidelines. Manage email lists, segmentation, and targeting strategies. Monitor campaign performance and analyze key metrics such as open rates, click-through rates, and conversions. Perform A/B testing to optimize subject lines, content, and campaign performance. Ensure email deliverability and compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM). Collaborate with design, content, and marketing teams to align campaigns with business goals. Maintain and update email templates and marketing automation tools. Identify opportunities to improve engagement and retention through lifecycle email marketing. Required Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Strong written communication and copywriting skills. Basic understanding of email marketing tools (e.g., Mailchimp, Hub Spot, Zoho Campaigns). Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data. Attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Familiarity with MS Office and basic reporting. - Email Marketing Specialist || Dehradun Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India Full Time Experienced Share We are seeking a creative and data-driven Email Marketing Specialist with 0- 1 year of experience to plan, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving engagement, increasing conversions, and improving customer retention through effective email strategies. Plan, create, and execute email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and automated workflows. Design and develop engaging email content aligned with brand guidelines. Manage email lists, segmentation, and targeting strategies. Monitor campaign performance and analyze key metrics such as open rates, click-through rates, and conversions. Perform A/B testing to optimize subject lines, content, and campaign performance. Ensure email deliverability and compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM). Collaborate with design, content, and marketing teams to align campaigns with business goals. Maintain and update email templates and marketing automation tools. Identify opportunities to improve engagement and retention through lifecycle email marketing. Required Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Strong written communication and copywriting skills. Basic understanding of email marketing tools (e.g., Mailchimp, Hub Spot, Zoho Campaigns). Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data. Attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Familiarity with MS Office and basic reporting. The people here love what they do because everyone from management all way down understands how much it means living up close-to someones' ideals which allows every day feel less stressful knowing each person has somebody cheering him. Equal Opportunity Employer: Ebiz ON is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees, and we will consider any qualified applicant without regard to race or other prohibited characteristics. It helps them thrive and also balance their life better. That's why you'll find us working closely with clients from around the world through Microsoft Teams, Zoom and other video conferencing tools. Retreats & Celebrations: With annual retreats, quarterly town halls and festive celebrations we have a lot of opportunities to get together. Leave Policy: Leave policies allow for 52 weekends and 32 days of leave per year, plus maternity, paternity or sabbatical allowances. Ebiz ON ll CAD Assistant ll Gurgaon Gurgaon, India Full Time Entry Level Share Ebiz ON is looking for skilled CAD Assistants across Mechanical, Electrical, and CCT functions to support engineering design and drafting activities. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with CAD tools and the ability to prepare accurate engineering drawings as per project requirements.
1. CAD Assistant – Mechanical Qualification: Graduate / Diploma in Mechanical or Civil Engineering Skills &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strong proficiency in Auto CAD . Ability to prepare structural drawings , P&ID drawings , or other engineering layouts. Support engineers in generating detailed 2D drawings, models, and documentation. Ensure drawing accuracy, adherence to standards, and timely delivery.
2. CAD Assistant – Electrical Qualification: Graduate / Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering Skills &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Proficient in Auto CAD . Experience in preparing electrical schematics , system drawings , and wiring diagrams. Support the electrical design team in documentation, drafting, and technical detailing. Maintain drawing standards and coordinate with engineering teams.
3. CAD Assistant – CCT Qualification: Graduate / Diploma in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering Skills &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Experience in CAD software ; knowledge of UG-NX preferred. Hands-on experience in part modelling , 2D drafting, and conversion. Experience with Teamcenter will be an advantage. Support 3D modelling, design changes, and engineering documentation. Requirement: Greater than 3 Years of experience for a Diploma Holder Greater than 2 years of experience for a Graduate General Competencies (All Streams) Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and guidelines. Good coordination skills with internal engineering teams. Ability to work under timelines and deliver high-quality outputs. About Us Ebiz ON is a global team specializing in building technology products and driving growth through multi-channel digital marketing. We’ve partnered with Fortune companies, e Commerce brands, Saa S firms, and VC-funded startups—helping over a dozen billion-dollar companies with consulting, technology, and digital transformation. We take pride in our fun, collaborative, and growth-focused culture built on integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness, and teamwork. Our goal is simple—make life better by giving people peace of mind through impactful solutions. Why Join Us Equal Opportunity Employer: We value diversity and inclusivity across all teams. Flexible Timings: Enjoy the freedom to balance work and life your way. Global Exposure: Collaborate with clients worldwide through virtual platforms like Teams and Zoom. Retreats & Celebrations: Connect, unwind, and celebrate with fun Fridays and festive events. Generate qualified B2B leads using Linked In and Linked In Sales Navigator. Research and identify decision-makers across target industries. Send personalized connection requests and follow-up messages. Build and maintain prospect databases. Qualify leads and coordinate with the sales team for handover. Update CRM with accurate lead information. Meet daily, weekly, and monthly lead generation targets. Required Skills: 1–3 years of experience in Linked In lead generation or B2B prospecting. Hands-on experience with Linked In Sales Navigator. Strong communication and research skills. Experience with CRM tools and Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets. Self-motivated with the ability to achieve lead generation goals. Network Engineer ( N1 ) Gurugram, Haryana, India Full Time Experienced Share Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer L2 to join our IT/Networking team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience configuring and managing routers, switches, and firewalls, ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of our network infrastructure. Qualifications and Skills: B.Tech / B.E / B.Sc. in Computer Science / IT / ECE engineering, BCA. Location: Delhi / NCR Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Configure, monitor, and maintain network devices including routers, switches, and firewalls. Troubleshoot and resolve network issues to minimize downtime and maintain service level agreements (SLAs). Implement network security policies and firewall rules to safeguard the organization’s IT assets. Perform network performance tuning, capacity planning, and traffic analysis. Assist in the deployment and configuration of new network hardware and software. Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for network upgrades and projects. Support incident management and provide escalation support for complex network issues. Required Skills & Experience: Proven experience with router, switch, and firewall configuration and management. Knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VPN, VLANs, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP). Experience with network monitoring tools and troubleshooting network performance issues. Understanding of network security principles and best practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, Palo Alto/Checkpoint, or similar are a plus. Self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience selling to clients in the US, Europe, or other international markets. Familiarity with Linked In Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo, Hub Spot, Salesforce, or similar sales tools. Exposure to digital marketing services, web development, e Commerce solutions, or technology consulting services. Ebiz ON has many values that are important to our success as a company: integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness and teamwork. We thrive on the idea of making life better for people by providing them with peace of mind. The people here love what they do because everyone from management all way down understands how much it means living up close-to someones' ideals which allows every day feel less stressful knowing each person has somebody cheering him. Senior Account Manager – Business Development Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India Full Time Mid Level Share Ebiz ON is looking for a Senior Account Manager – Business Development to join our team in our Noida office. The primary responsibility of this role is to manage key accounts, generate new business opportunities, and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate will have experience in client relationship management, sales strategy, and end-to-end business development.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Manage and grow relationships with existing clients/accounts Identify and generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and outreach Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline Understand client requirements and propose customized tech and digital marketing solutions Deliver presentations, proposals, and negotiate contracts Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, delivery, operations) for seamless project execution Stay updated on market trends, digital solutions, and competitor activities Maintain accurate records and updates in CRM systems Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field 2–5 years of experience in Business Development / Account Management / Sales Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills Proven ability to close deals and achieve revenue targets Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and MS Office About Us Ebiz ON is a global team specializing in building technology products and driving growth through multi-channel digital marketing. We’ve partnered with Fortune companies, e Commerce brands, Saa S firms, and VC-funded startups—helping over a dozen billion-dollar companies with consulting, technology, and digital transformation. We take pride in our fun, collaborative, and growth-focused culture built on integrity, creativity, innovation, mindfulness, and teamwork. Our goal is simple—make life better by giving people peace of mind through impactful solutions. Why Join Us Equal Opportunity Employer: We value diversity and inclusivity across all teams. Flexible Timings: Enjoy the freedom to balance work and life your way. Global Exposure: Collaborate with clients worldwide through virtual platforms like Teams and Zoom. Retreats & Celebrations: Connect, unwind, and celebrate with fun Fridays and festive events.
